status: example: placeholder values, not measured. Copy to a file of your own and record every value at bring-up (software/benchsim/docs/bringup.md A1-A5).

notes.convention: q_rad = sign * (ticks - tick_at_zero) * 2 pi / ticks_per_rev; q is the upstream so101_new_calib MJCF joint angle
notes.tick_at_zero: Present_Position (raw, normalize=False) with the arm in the MJCF zero pose. 2047 is assumed: LeRobot's calibration puts each joint's half-turn homing at 2047
notes.gripper: two-point map: tick_closed at deg_closed (jaws touching) and tick_open at deg_open; placeholders assume 1:1 with the MJCF gripper joint
notes.limits: min_deg/max_deg default to the MJCF joint ranges rounded inward; narrow them to the bench's safe range
notes.fingerprint: null until recorded: {joint: [Homing_Offset, Min_Position_Limit, Max_Position_Limit]} read with LeRobotArm.read_fingerprint(); a mismatch refuses the arm (wrong port or swapped arms)
notes.speeds: max_speed_deg_s is capped by bench_params [arm] max_speed_deg_s; 60 deg/s is a bring-up value (assumed); acceleration_deg_s2 is written to the STS3215 Acceleration register (assumed)
